name: [⚔️] Kit PVP FFA
desc:
⚔️ KIT PVP – fast block PvP with modern 1.21-style combat!
Pick a kit, drop into the free-for-all arena and fight. Real 1.21 PvP: attack cooldown, crits, sweeping, shields, knockback and armor.

🗡️ 8 KITS: Sword, Mace, Mace & Spear, Elytra & Rockets, TNT, End Crystals, Archer and Orbital Strike
💥 Mace PvP, crystal PvP, respawn anchors, wind charges, spear lunges, elytra mace combos, ender pearls, totems and golden apples
🧱 Build, bridge and blow up the map: it resets every 5 minutes
🔥 Killstreaks, bounties and kill perks like Super Mode
⭐ Level up to 200, then Prestige
🎁 Open crates for skins, sword skins, capes and auras, up to Divine (0.1%)
📅 Daily rewards + a free reward for joining the group
🏆 Climb the Top Kills leaderboard
🎮 PC, phone and controller, with rebindable controls and F5 third person

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Minecraft or Microsoft.

llm.loop: pick a kit -> drop into FFA arena -> fight with Minecraft 1.21-style combat -> earn XP/coins, killstreaks, bounties -> level to 200 and prestige, open crates for skins
llm.objectives: get kills and killstreaks, climb the Top Kills leaderboard, level up and prestige
llm.progression: levels up to 200 then prestige, crate skins (up to Divine 0.1%), ranks
llm.instructions: pick one of 8 kits, fight in the free-for-all arena; build, bridge and blow up the map, which resets every 5 minutes
unique: faithful recreation of Minecraft 1.21 combat (mace, wind charges, crystal PvP, spear lunges) in a Roblox FFA arena
monetization_signals: permanent XP multiplier passes up to 4096x
llm.thumbnails: blocky Minecraft-style character with diamond sword and PVP text, hotbar with mace/spear/end crystal items, first-person combat with crit particles
llm.complexity_notes: custom combat system replicating Minecraft mechanics, destructible block map with resets, 8 kits, crate and level systems
